summary: M.S. Computer Engineering graduate from RIT with hands-on experience building signal processing pipelines, computer vision algorithms, and sensor integration systems in Python3 and C++. Developed surface inspection and calibration pipelines at BARC using wavelet denoising (PSNR 86); deployed OpenCV visual servoing on NVIDIA Jetson with 100% pick reliability.

experience.title: Research Intern (Capstone)
bullets: Architected a metal surface inspection pipeline using custom image stitching, wavelet denoising, and monocular depth estimation — improving PSNR from 65 to 86 over the homography baseline.
Designed a custom wavelet bank for signal noise suppression with concurrent processing; validated algorithm accuracy through iterative PSNR-based quantitative evaluation.

experience.title: Python Developer Intern
bullets: Built a Python3 data acquisition GUI (PyQt + Matplotlib + numpy) for real-time laboratory sensor data visualization and experimental analysis.
Maintained version control workflows on GitLab; managed collaborative analysis notebooks on JupyterHub for tabular data processing and technical documentation.

experience.title: Research Fellowship
bullets: Engineered a custom Python3 data pipeline for BraTS 2020 multi-modal MRI dataset with medical imaging augmentation and batch-loading for large-scale 3D volumetric inputs.
Trained U-Net segmentation with VGG-16 and ResNet-50 backbones; evaluated on Dice Score and IoU; documented accuracy-latency trade-offs across backbone configurations.

experience.title: General Secretary
bullets: Led 25-member robotics team across national competitions; owned PCB fabrication and sensor integration end-to-end.
Implemented sensor communication over UART and I2C with closed-loop feedback on custom PCBs designed in EAGLE.
Authored onboarding documentation and ran 10+ technical workshops covering Arduino, PCB design, and robotics frameworks.

projects.name: Voice-Controlled Robotic Arm (COFFIN) — MS Capstone, RIT
bullets: Deployed TensorRT YOLO visual servoing at ~18 FPS on NVIDIA Jetson; integrated dual VL53L0X ToF sensors via TCA9548A I2C mux — 100% pick reliability (10/10 trials) at ~11.5s end-to-end latency.
Implemented two-link IK in C++ on Arduino; drove five servos with range-gated contact detection and sensor-calibrated motion thresholds.

awards: 1st Prize, Poster Presentation — 2D and 3D Image Mosaicing of Microscopic Images, F.C.R.I.T. (2024)
